title: Animal Comix and Stories #1
desc: Funny animal comics fans will rejoice over this all-new one-shot comic book from the mighty pen of Noah Van Sciver! Meet Hefty Duck, a hyperbolic, paranoid narcissist! Will he find a job in this economy? Also introducing: the criminal rat brothers! Dinky Doormouse! Duncan the rabbit! In the grand tradition of Fritz the Cat, Disney Ducks, Pogo and more, Van Sciver makes the comic bookstore safe once again for anthropomorphic hijinx!
